Walchandnagar Industries was founded by [[Walchand Hirachand|Walchand Hirachand Doshi]] in 1908.{{cite web |url=http://www.walchand.com/histroy.htm |title=Walchandnagar Industries Ltd |publisher=Walchand.com |date=1919-04-05 |accessdate=2010-09-28 |archive-date=29 May 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100529082153/http://www.walchand.com/histroy.htm |url-status=dead India|date=1998-11-30|accessdate=2012-01-08}} for its involvement in India's nuclear and space programs.{{cite web|url=http://www.fas.org/nuke/guide/india/contractor/index.html|title=Defense
